sharedRules.name: Armoured Reserve
sharedRules.description: In missions with Deep Reserves, you may only field one Tank Unit with Armoured Reserve, one Tank Unit with Front Armour of 3 or more, or one Aircraft Unit on the table at the start of the game.

sharedRules.name: Hunters
sharedRules.description: Infantry Teams treat Snow, Woods, and Forests as Cross-country Dash instead of Terrain Dash.

sharedRules.name: HEAT
sharedRules.description: Target Armour is not increased by +1 if it is more than 16"/40cm away.

rules.name: Pioneer Company
rules.description: Infantry Units in the Formation Dig In on a roll of 2+.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Discard this card to re-roll any one die you rolled. The second result must be used.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: At the start of the game, after deployment, reposition one of your opponent's Ranged In Markers up to 6"/15cm in any direction.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Discard this card before rolling to automatically pass an Armour or Infantry Save (including all re-rolls) made by this Formation Commander.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Increasse this Formation Commander's Command Leadership distance from 6"/15cm to 8"/20cm.
Discard this card: Automatically pass one Unit Last Stand Test for a Unit from this Formation whose Unit Leader is within 8"/20cm of the Formation Commander.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Hits by this Formation Commander may only be swapped using the Mistaken Target rule on 4+ instead of 3+.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: This Formation HQ is Concealed when Halted.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: This Formation Commander rolls two dice instead of one To Hit during Assaults.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: This Formation Commander may re-roll failed To Hit rolls when Shooting during Defensive Fire while being assaulted.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Discard this card: Units in Formation whose Unit Leader is within 8"/20cm of this Formation Commander pass Blitz Movement Orders on a 2+ until the end of the turn.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: This Formation HQ Unit passes Tactics tests for Movement Orders on 2+

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Place this card next to a building that your Formation HQ Unit is occupying. For the rest of the game, Infantry Teams in this building have a 2+ Save.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: This Formation Commander HIts on 2+ in Assaults.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: If the Unit Leader of a Unit in this Formation is within 6"/15cm and in Line of Sight of the Formation Commander, the Unit passes Blitz tests and Last Stand checks on 2+.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
In each Shooting Step, pick one INfantry Team from this Unit. This Team may re-roll one failed To Hit Roll.

If this shot hits its target, target Team must re-roll a successful Save.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Discard this card to give Infantry and Gun Teams in this Unit Anti-tank 3 and Firepower 1+ against Top Armour in Assault until the end of this turn.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: This Unit Leader may re-roll one failed Firepower Test during the Shooting Step.
